name: phase_shape
summary: Vector phaseshaping (VPS, DAFx-11 — Kleimola/Lazzarini/Timoney/Välimäki): one 2-D inflection point p=(d,v) reshapes the phase ramp piecewise-linearly before the wave read. `d` = the breakpoint's x-coordinate (0..1), a settable, modulatable param (wired `d_mod` + `d_depth`); `v` = its y-coordinate (control) — `v` > 1 wraps forward past the cycle (uint32, one wrap: v < 2), `v` < 0 saturates to 0. Classic phase distortion is the v=0.5 case (`phase_dist`). Both are control-rate (the slopes are block_derived).
